objective: Metadata record of a published AMS-02 result (Precision Measurement of the Proton Flux, 1 GV-1.8 TV, PRL 114, 171103); no data values are transcribed
unresolved_inputs: data values, uncertainties and covariance: transcribe from the paper or its Supplemental Material with a new claim before use
bin semantics: not recorded in the ledger

observable.process: primary cosmic rays at the detector location

phase_space.definition: as defined in the source paper (not transcribed here)

normalization.convention: flux = counts / (exposure x bin width); exposure values are not public here

conventions.ams02:rigidity_definition: R = pc/(Ze) in GV; p = |Z|R/c; rigidity is not momentum

covariance.note: not transcribed; the paper's own uncertainty breakdown governs
